title: feat(nsgram): nnseed Gram signature is (1,2,0), equals gram4
science: Minkowski Gram on the nnseed tick list (2,1,2): G=((3,1,3),(1,-1,0),(3,0,1)), exact LDL pivots (3,-4/3,-5/4), leading minors (3,-4,5), signature (1,2,0). Crucially it also computes the 1-seed Gram on the same three sites with the real perp ticks (3,2,3): G_1=((8,5,8),(5,2,4),(8,4,6)), entrywise different but ALSO signature (1,2,0). Euclidean mutation gives (3,0,0).
